thread:
Maya: quick heads-up 1: q5b-int4 bringup shows -5.8% F1 on summarization gold (2k). Latency ok but quality drop is non-negligible, need fast triage.
Rafael: can you paste the eval command + exact checkpoint + seed?
Maya: ran: `./eval/run --model q5b_int4_kv --ckpt q5b-2026-03-21 --task summarization --seed 7 --batch 16`
Maya: numbers: ROUGE-1 -3.9, ROUGE-L -4.5, F1 -5.8. tail latency p95 improved ~22%.
Sasha: first thought: token-id shifts from the tokenizer remap we pushed last week. small remaps + int4 quant boundaries can flip beam ordering.
Lina: also new ingest merge from partner-y (60k docs) landed yesterday. we haven't applied the dedupe policy yet. could be different prompt prefixes creeping into eval samples.
Rafael: let's isolate variables. Proposal: freeze the canonical gold for this triage (no dataset updates). run three quick checks:
- A: q5b_int4 with compat-tokenizer and old kvcache kernel
- B: q5b_int4 with current tokenizer v4 and new kvcache kernel (what Maya ran)
- C: fp16 baseline with current tokenizer (sanity)
Maya: agree. i'll run A and B and upload token diffs for failing items.
Sasha: i'll prepare a small script to diff tokenization:
```
python tools/token_diff.py 
  --left sample.fp16.tokenids 
  --right sample.q5b.tokenids 
  --out diffs.json
```
Sasha: if we see consistent off-by-one at prefix boundary that's a remap problem.
Lina: on dataset: i'm against changing gold now. but i will sample 200 items from partner-y ingest and spin up a manual audit so we can see whether the new docs amplify the regression. i'll label it `q5b-quick-audit-200`.
Lina: /label create --name "q5b-quick-audit-200" --n 200 --tags src:partner-y,ingest:v2.0-remap,tok:v4
Maya: good. include reviewer checklist: truncation, missing context, hallucination, tokenization mismatch.
Rafael: timeline? can we get A/B runs within 45m?
Maya: yes, starting A now. will post notebook link and artifacts.
deploy-bot: ci/eval-q5b triggered by Maya at 1729501258 1 job=66211
Sasha: quick note 1: if compat-tokenizer recovers >3% F1 we should consider adding a tiny pre-tokenizer mapping step to the quant path as a mitigation while we sort kernel/quantization.
Lina: if remediation requires dataset changes (dedupe rules) i propose strict simhash=0.92 + canonical id union and a 48-hour manual spotcheck before rolling any gold updates.
Maya: if regression persists after A then we'll escalate: revert kernel selection for nightly runs and pin tokenizer to compat for the next 2 nights.
Rafael: okay sounds like a plan. i'll watch the token diff artifacts and run a quick statistical breakdown by prompt template once results are in.
Lina: first 50 labeled items should be ready in ~3 hours, i'll ping when reviewers can start.
Maya: thx all, posting notebook soon. :rocket:
